page.overview:
Who is Azzlan?

Azzlan is a Christian lion who tries to convert everybody in to his religion

When Marge learned that her mother was gravely ill, Azzlan saw an opportunity to try and convert her to Christianity. Armed with a handful of pamphlets, he visited her. However, Marge quickly saw through his intentions. Frustrated, she promptly threw him out of the house, pamphlet and all.

Later that evening, Homer turned to Lisa and casually said, "Mom's the word." As if summoned by some sort of mystical force, Azzlan materialized in the doorway and asked, "Did someone say *the word*?"

Homer and Lisa exchanged a tired glance before exhaled synchronized sighs. "Hi, Azzlan," they muttered in unison.
